name: Lazylibrarian
description: Lazylibrarian is a program to follow authors and grab metadata for all your digital reading needs. It uses a combination of Goodreads Librarything and optionally GoogleBooks as sources for author info and book info. This container is based on the DobyTang fork.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  lazylibrarian:
    environment:
      DOCKER_MODS: linuxserver/calibre-web:calibre|linuxserver/mods:lazylibrarian-ffmpeg
      PGID: $PGID
      PUID: $PUID
      TZ: $TZ
    image: linuxserver/lazylibrarian:version-169e669f
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 64M
    network_mode: bridge
    ports:
      - target: 5299
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${SHARED_DIR}/Downloads
        target: /downloads
      - type: bind
        source: ${SHARED_DIR}/Media/Books
        target: /books
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
    container_name: lazylibrarian
